title: Network proxy
description: Every outbound request from the backend (model APIs, IM platforms, hub, update checks, remote MCP, web fetch, child processes) follows this policy; intranet and whitelisted hosts connect directly.
modeOffDesc: Always connect directly and hide HTTP_PROXY-style variables from the process
modeSystemDesc: Use HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / ALL_PROXY / NO_PROXY as exported at startup; with none set, the OS proxy settings
modeManualDesc: Use the proxies below; they are also exported to the process so child processes inherit them
httpHint: For http:// targets; falls back to the catch-all proxy when empty
httpsHint: For https:// and wss:// targets; http, https, socks5 and socks5h are accepted
allHint: Used when the HTTP / HTTPS proxies are empty
passwordKeep: A password is stored; leave empty to keep it
bypassHint: One per line: domains (*.corp.example or .corp.example), hosts, host:port, IPs, CIDR blocks (10.0.0.0/8); <local> means hostnames without a dot
bypassPrivateDesc: Link-local, 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, fc00::/7 and *.local / *.internal / *.lan never use the proxy; localhost / 127.0.0.0/8 / ::1 always connect directly
restartHint: Existing long-lived connections (IM channels, open model clients) pick up the new policy on their next reconnect or after a restart.
invalidUrl: Proxy URL looks wrong; use http://host:port or socks5h://host:port
